face.description: The name of the face that shows (front, back, top, left side...), the same name for the same face in every frame. Empty when no broad face shows.
face.title: Face

parts.description: The parts drawn on that face in this frame, each in a few words with where it sits. Empty when none can be made out.
parts.title: Parts

seen.description: broad_face: a face of the product shows. edge_only: the product is seen so thin that no broad face shows. not_visible: the product is out of view or fully hidden.
seen.title: Seen

thin_edge_side.description: On which side of the broad face, in the picture, the visible thin edge of the product sits. none when no thin edge shows or no broad face shows.
thin_edge_side.title: Thin Edge Side

time.description: The frame's time in seconds, as labelled.
time.title: Time

from_time.description: The last frame before the turn that shows a broad face.
from_time.title: From Time

to_time.description: The first frame after the turn that shows a broad face.
to_time.title: To Time

why.description: One sentence: the motion cue you used, with frame times.
why.title: Why

across_frames.description: Which sides of each main object were seen, in which frames; whether a side that came into view is a real side; whether a part appeared or vanished on a side that kept facing the camera.
across_frames.title: Across Frames

back_to_normal_at.description: When is this thing back to normal? Give the second, or say never.
back_to_normal_at.title: Back To Normal At

problem.description: When it fails: up to 3 sentences: the object and what is impossible about it, the frame time, and what a real one would look like. Null when it passes.
problem.title: Problem
